FOUNDATIONS.workspace-and-context.predicate: This reliance or next authorized operation has sufficient support on its bound subject/basis, applicable reusable evidence and sufficiently observed material effects.
FOUNDATIONS.workspace-and-context.applicability: Acquisition, continuation and reuse against a bound workspace/subject and authoritative external state, including currentness-sensitive effects and dependent retries.
obligations: Observe the subject/basis actually bound, including selected frozen snapshots. Admissible contrary current evidence reopens affected claims through drift/re-entry and does not silently change the selected basis. Current observations correct stale belief but cannot authorize weakening requirements to match implementation; what exists and what must exist remain distinct.

Bind task, subject, destination, authority and relevant observations. Include known material dependencies directly or through declared available inputs; exclude irrelevant material unless needed to establish irrelevance. Rules without the actual subject, digests without accessible meaning and stale unsupported summaries are insufficient. Absence from a partial projection/sparse checkout/empty local record does not prove bound-subject absence: obtain authoritative evidence or retain indeterminacy.

Each observation identifies source and time/version. If state may change before effect, supply material freshness/concurrency support through re-observation, revision comparison, protected snapshot or uncertainty. Never assume a stale read remains current.

Reuse requires same claim scope, adequate current basis/evidence, valid dependencies and required independent authorship. Changed support reopens affected dependent claims and invalidates their reliance while preserving history. Unchanged independent work remains usable; inspect the wider affected scope when independence is unproved. A stored green label is insufficient; the continuing consumer checks exact applicability. Production and invalidation of relied-on support remain recoverable.

Before dependent repetition with uncertain effects, observe/reconcile sufficiently to decide the next action. Otherwise choose another permitted action or return unresolved. Retained partial progress does not imply idempotence.

Context fit and attention adequacy are distinct predicates: the execution binding declares the resource envelope and measurement boundary; bytes/tokens establish fit only for measured context. Actual use establishes adequate application of relevant material for the selected task under those conditions. Neither proves the other, and no universal attention score follows.
permissions_exceptions: No universal isolation scheme is prescribed.

The cycle may stop after any operation without completion. Context may be discarded; resume by reconstructing sufficient context from continuing work and authoritative inputs, preserving progress without needing every previous transcript.
A function, component, role, conversation, status or resumption boundary alone is not an invalidator; the continuing consumer checks exact applicability.

Retry a granted operation when idempotence is established for this actual subject and effect. Event logs may support observation, audit or domain reconstruction; they are neither universally the work state nor a mandatory recovery algorithm.
